scope: Every original PLY vertex processed without dropping or sampling. Supplied normal anchors determine graph-consistent component signs. Source normals are a scanner reference, not independent physical truth.

diagnostics.orientationAssumption: PCA estimates every point; graph-consistent component signs follow aggregate agreement with valid supplied normal anchors. Invalid anchors are counted and do not remove points.

limitations: Local PCA changes valid source normals as well as estimating invalid ones.
The spanning forest aligns nearby tangent estimates; complex touching sheets, outliers and inconsistent source anchors can remain ambiguous.
A completed preprocessing run is not a reconstructed mesh quality certificate.
